images.title: What is RAG in AI?
images.subtitle: How a chatbot looks things up in your documents before it answers, and where that goes wrong.

images.title: RAG is a receptionist who checks the binder first

pairs.left: Reads it out, names the page

images.note: Where it stops: a person notices an odd page. A model usually trusts what it is handed.

images.title: The answer is written from passages found a second ago

items.label: Split
items.text: Cut documents into short passages, once, ahead of time.

items.label: Index
items.text: Store each passage so it can be searched by meaning.

items.label: Retrieve
items.text: Find the passages closest to the question.

items.label: Answer
items.text: Send passages and question to the model. It answers and names the source.

images.note: Steps 1 and 2 happen before anyone asks. Steps 3 and 4 happen on every question.

images.title: Reading the right page beats answering from memory

columns.heading: Without RAG
items: Answers from what it learned in training
Knows nothing about your private files

columns.heading: With RAG
items: Reads passages found for this question
Fresh as the documents you store
Can point to the passage it used

images.verdict: RAG is only as good as the passages it finds.
